entity.summary: Historical Android Bitcoin privacy wallet whose web servers/domain were seized by law enforcement in April 2024 and whose business was closed.
entity.notes: The official source repository establishes the historical Android wallet. U.S. DOJ records say Samourai was developed/operated from about 2015 and that its web servers/domain were seized on 2024-04-24, with the FBI stating the business was closed. The still-accessible source repository is not treated as active-service evidence.

products.summary: Historical Samourai Android Bitcoin wallet, no longer operating after the April 2024 law-enforcement seizure and closure.
products.notes: DOJ states Samourai's web servers/domain were seized on 2024-04-24, a seizure warrant was served on the Google Play app, and the business was closed. The source repository remains available but is not evidence of current service/support.

events.title: Samourai Wallet infrastructure seized and service closed
events.description: U.S. authorities seized Samourai Wallet web servers and the samourai.io domain, served a seizure warrant on the mobile application, and the FBI stated that Samourai Wallet was closed for business.
events.notes: This event records the operational seizure and shutdown boundary only. It does not restate criminal allegations as adjudicated facts. The canonical Android product already records discontinued_date=2024-04-24 and support_status=ended.

evidence.title: Samourai Wallet Android source repository
evidence.notes: Official Samourai organization repository establishes the historical Android wallet identity and prior Google Play release lineage.
